headline: Argentina enters technical recession with third-quarter GDP contraction
summary: Argentina's economy shrank 1.8% in the third quarter, marking its second consecutive decline as weak consumption and falling purchasing power weigh on activity.
why: Gross domestic product contractions signal economic downturns that impact corporate revenues, employment, and sovereign risk evaluations.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: A broad economic contraction directly affects national output, business performance, and fiscal health.
